svg.title: Native gates: the hooks around each worker and the orchestrator's final reply
svg.desc: The orchestrator sends the plan to a reviewer, then launches workers. plan-check.mjs (PreToolUse on Agent) blocks an implementer brief with missing lines, a file overlap, a dependency cycle, no plan review, a slice or file that is not in the plan, or an isolated launch whose worktree would not start from HEAD, and a built-in or fork agent while a run is open; it blocks the implementer of a stalled slice with replan_required. Otherwise it lets the launch through, and for this plugin's agents (never a built-in or fork) it may send one updatedInput: a haiku model is raised to sonnet (on by default), the read router raises a researcher's model for the tier of its SOURCES files (opt-in, never lower) and the skill hints append up to 3 suggested skills (1 for a reviewer, 2 for one on opus or above). researcher-guard.mjs denies a researcher's Bash command unless it is read-only, and egress-guard.mjs denies a reviewer's WebFetch to a host its brief and files do not name. When an implementer stops, verify.sh blocks it with the test output while the tests fail in the shared tree (in an isolated worktree it only warns by default; by default it marks failures that also fail on the base as probably pre-existing; an opt-in allow mode lets it finish when every failure also fails on the base; off skips the base run), and blocks a KIND: bugfix slice that has no test failing on the base. When a researcher reports, quote-check.mjs blocks it once for a quote not found in its source; in auto mode, at a worker's hand-back, handback-check.mjs sends a report back once when it has no STATUS line or a reviewer's pass leaves a checked id unanswered. review-gate.mjs (Stop) defers while agents run and blocks the final reply while an implementer has no later reviewer, the last review failed (a gap of 80 or more or a failed check; lower gaps pass with a doubt signal), an opus review is missing after a doubt signal, a checked constraint is unanswered, a stalled slice has no replan, or an implementer started and never stopped. The test and review gates and most plan checks let the work through after 2 blocks; file overlap and dependency cycle block every time, the guards deny every time, and quote-check and handback-check send a report back once.
svg.text: [implementer brief: missing lines, file overlap, dependency cycle, no plan review,
slice or files not in the plan, or an isolated launch whose worktree would not start from HEAD;
or a built-in or fork agent while a run is open]
[implementer of a stalled slice: the same gap in two failed reviews in a row]
[implementer allowed, or a researcher or reviewer (never blocked)]
One updatedInput, only for this plugin's agents (never a built-in or fork):
Haiku rule (on by default): any of the five agents asked to run on a haiku model runs on sonnet.
Read router (opt-in): a researcher with SOURCES gets the model for its files' tier, raised, never lowered.
Skill hints: up to 3 suggested skills found on disk (1 for a reviewer, 2 on opus), appended to the brief.
[tests fail in the shared tree (an isolated worktree only warns by default)]
[tests pass, but a KIND: bugfix slice has no test that fails on the base]
[tests pass or are skipped; or, in allow mode, every failing test also fails on the base]
[a QUOTE line is not found in its source (at the hand-back in auto mode, else at the stop)]
[no STATUS line in the report (at the hand-back, auto mode)]
[quotes found, or read from a scan or a URL]
STATUS, GAP lines with a confidence
[a subagent or workflow is still running]
[no reviewer after the last implementer, the last review failed, no opus review after a doubt signal,
a checked constraint left unanswered, a stalled slice without its replan, or an implementer that never stopped]
Solid arrow: call or event. Dashed arrow: reply or hook decision. Time runs down.
A review fails on a failed checked id or a gap of 80 or more; lower gaps pass with a doubt signal.
In auto mode handback-check.mjs also sends a reviewer's report back once, before delivery, when its pass leaves a checked id unanswered.
After 2 blocks the test gate, the review gate and most plan checks let the work through; overlap and cycle block every time, the guards always deny, quote-check blocks once.
Test baseline: by default the block marks failures that also fail on the base as probably pre-existing; allow mode (opt-in) lets the implementer finish; off skips the base run.
